'''Chrilooc''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He once sent a spacer to steal medical supplies from a group of [[Gotal Bandits]]. Chrilooc could sometimes be found with his associate [[Brody Johnson|Johnson Smith]] at an [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] compound in [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy]].
